#### 1. Glanzmann thrombasthenia  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.429)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-114608)

**Proposed mechanism:** ITGA2B (HGNC:5683) —DISRUPTS→ Integrin alpha-IIb/beta-3 signaling (GO:0007173); ITGB3 (HGNC:5677) —DISRUPTS→ Integrin alpha-IIb/beta-3 signaling (GO:0007173); Integrin alpha-IIb/beta-3 signaling (GO:0007173) —LEADS_TO→ Impaired platelet aggregation (HP:0001942); Impaired platelet aggregation (HP:0001942) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal bleeding (HP:0011417); Integrin alpha-IIb/beta-3 signaling (GO:0007173) —LEADS_TO→ Thrombocytopenia (HP:0001873). Mutations in either ITGA2B (encoding integrin alpha-IIb) or ITGB3 (encoding integrin beta-3) disrupt the formation and function of the crucial platelet integrin alpha-IIb/beta-3 complex. This leads to impaired platelet aggregation, abnormal bleeding, and in some cases, thrombocytopenia.

**How to falsify it:** Discovery of individuals with pathogenic variants in either ITGA2B or ITGB3 exhibiting normal platelet aggregation and hemostasis, or the identification of distinct molecular pathways uniquely contributing to each disease's phenotype. _(variant: rs115758556 (ITGB3, p.L190X) has a gnomAD allele frequency > 0.001)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of the integrin alpha-IIb/beta-3 complex in both Glanzmann thrombasthenia and potentially other bleeding disorders linked to platelet dysfunction can inform diagnostic strategies and therapeutic interventions targeting platelet aggregation and bleeding.
